name: ibis budget Singapore Imperial
short_description: A 2-star budget hotel on Penhas Road near Lavender, about a 5-minute walk from Lavender MRT, with a rooftop pool and around 74 compact rooms.
ai_summary: ibis budget Singapore Imperial sits on Penhas Road in the Lavender/Kallang area -- formerly branded Fragrance Hotel Imperial -- about a 5-minute walk from Lavender MRT Station and within walking distance of Kampong Glam and Haji Lane. The property has around 74 economy rooms with flat-screen TVs, air conditioning, and mini fridges, plus a rooftop swimming pool and on-site dining including Sen Restaurant and a coffee shop. Guest reviews are largely positive on cleanliness, staff friendliness, and the convenient location near an MRT station, supermarkets, and 24-hour convenience stores, with recurring complaints about small room sizes, thin walls/soundproofing, and firm mattresses. The hotel does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme's points or elite-tier benefits, though ALL members can still book member rates.

faqs.question: How far is ibis budget Singapore Imperial from Lavender MRT station?
faqs.answer: The hotel is about a 5-minute walk from Lavender MRT Station. From there, it's roughly a 10-minute drive to Suntec City and Marina Square, and about a 15-minute train ride to Orchard Road.

faqs.question: Does ibis budget Singapore Imperial have a pool?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it has a rooftop swimming pool, which is an unusual amenity at this budget price tier. The hotel also has Sen Restaurant and a casual coffee shop/cafe on site.

faqs.question: Can ALL - Accor Live Limitless members earn points at ibis budget Singapore Imperial?
faqs.answer: No -- per the hotel's official ALL listing, this property does not participate in ALL points earning, redemption, or elite-tier benefits like room upgrades or lounge access. ALL members can still book member-exclusive rates when reserving directly through the ALL - Accor Live Limitless website or app.
